Author: Dipankar Datta
Bench: Dipankar Datta
 1
29.04.2016
Item No.41
 Sb
 W.P. 7441 (W) of 2016
 Bengal Beverages Pvt. Ltd. & Anr.
 Vs.
 Union of India & Ors.
 Mr. S. S. Banerjee,
 Mr. P. Sancheta,
 Ms. Payal Saha..........for the petitioners.

Mr. Anindya Sundar Chatterjee,
 Mr. Goutam Dinda............for the respondent no.3.
An order passed by the Adjudicating Officer, Kolkata Municipal Corporation under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 dated 08.03.2016 is under challenge in this writ petition.
It appears from the impugned order that the adjudicating officer is also the Joint Municipal Commissioner (R&S) of the Corporation.

In terms of Section 68 of the Act, an adjudicating officer must be an officer not below the rank of Additional District Magistrate of the District where the alleged offence is committed to be notified by the State Government.
Learned advocates appearing for the Corporation are presently not in a position to satisfy this Bench that the incumbent adjudicating officer is equal to the rank of additional district magistrate.
Operation of the impugned order shall remain stayed for two weeks.
Put up the writ petition on Friday next under the heading 'Motion'.

(DIPANKAR DATTA, J.)
